name: FXOapps Order Returns for WooCommerce
author: FXOapps

sections.description:
FXOapps Order Returns for WooCommerce adds a complete return workflow to WooCommerce stores. Logged-in customers start returns from My Account → Retur on eligible completed orders within your configured return period. Shop staff manage every request from Order Returns in wp-admin with status updates, search, filters, and email notifications when a new return is submitted.

This WordPress.org edition works without a license key or external account.

Free Features

Admin Dashboard

View return totals, open and completed counts, recent activity, status breakdown charts, return-option distribution, and a timeline for the recent period.

See Screenshot 1.

Return Management

Browse return requests in a searchable, filterable list with pagination. Open individual requests to review order and product details, customer contact information, return reason, handover details, selected return option, bank details when provided, and update return status.

See Screenshots 2–3.

Admin Settings

Configure the plugin under Order Returns → Settings:

  • General — return period in days, admin notification email, and date format for storefront and emails.
  • Return Flow — product condition and return reason rows, optional detail fields, and per-reason return shipping fee payer (shop or customer).
  • Return Options — enable built-in customer-facing return options such as bank transfer, store coupon, and product exchange, with translated labels.
  • Handover — courier return with shop-calls-courier or customer-calls-courier modes and editable notices.

See Screenshots 4–7.

Appearance

Customize the customer-facing return wizard with colors, border radius presets, input styling, and theme compatibility options.

See Screenshot 8.

Full Frontend Return Flow

Logged-in customers get a guided return experience in My Account: select a returnable product from a completed order, choose product condition and return reason, provide courier pickup details when handover is enabled, select a return option, enter bank details when required, and submit the request.

See Screenshots 9–16.

Also included in Free

  • Customer confirmation email and admin alert when a new return is submitted.
  • Editable storefront and admin translations, compatible with multilingual setups such as WPML and Polylang.
  • IBAN validation when bank transfer is selected.
  • In-admin support contact form.
  • WooCommerce HPOS (custom order tables) compatibility.

PRO Features

View FXOapps Order Returns PRO →

The following advanced features are available in the separate commercial FXOapps Order Returns PRO plugin:

Return experience

  • Guest returns without account login (public return page with order verification).
  • Group returns (multiple products from one order).
  • Customer product image uploads on returns.
  • Courier pickup date on the return form.
  • In-person handover at store locations.
  • Per-reason “shop calls courier” override on return shipping.

Store operations

  • Automatic stock restore when a return is completed.
  • WooCommerce store credit coupons for coupon-type returns (created when completed).
  • Bulk status actions on the returns list.
  • Internal admin notes on return records.
  • Print return / RMA slip.
  • Date range filter on the returns list.
  • Filter returns by return option and show the selected option in the list.

Reporting and exports

  • CSV export with current list filters.
  • Advanced dashboard with custom date range.
  • Returns by product and return reason statistics.
  • Scheduled and on-demand weekly return reports by email.

Automation and rules

  • Customizable customer and admin email templates.
  • Email notifications when return status changes.
  • Multiple admin notification email addresses.
  • Exclude selected products or categories from returns.
  • Per-category return period overrides.

Support

  • Priority support.

Upgrade to PRO

Need additional return management features? FXOapps Order Returns PRO adds advanced functionality for stores that need more control and flexibility.

View FXOapps Order Returns PRO →

See Order Returns → Settings → PRO Features in wp-admin for the full Free vs PRO comparison.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install FXOapps Order Returns for WooCommerce through the WordPress Plugins screen, or upload the fxoapps-order-returns-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. On activation, the plugin registers the Retur WooCommerce My Account endpoint.
  5. Go to Order Returns → Settings and configure your return period, return flow, return options, handover preferences, and appearance.
  6. Customers can start returns from My Account → Retur once return flow and options are configured.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Does this plugin require a license or external account?

No. This WordPress.org release works without a license key, subscription, or fxoapps.com account.

Where can customers start a return?

Logged-in customers use My Account → Retur. The plugin adds this WooCommerce account endpoint automatically.

Which orders can be returned?

By default, customers can return products from completed orders that are still within the configured return period (days since order completion).

Can return reasons and product conditions be configured?

Yes. Under Order Returns → Settings → Return Flow, you can add product condition labels, return reasons, optional detail fields, and choose who pays return shipping for each reason.

Can return options be configured?

Yes. Return Options lets you enable built-in options such as bank transfer, coupon, and product exchange, and edit their customer-facing labels.

Can courier handover be configured?

Yes. Handover settings let you enable courier returns, choose whether the shop or customer arranges the courier, and edit the related customer notices.

How do administrators manage incoming returns?

Use Order Returns → Returns for the list and search, and open any request to review details and update its status. Order Returns → Dashboard provides summary statistics and charts.

Can the frontend appearance be customized?

Yes. Order Returns → Settings → Appearance controls colors, border radius, input styling, and theme compatibility for the return wizard.

Does the plugin send email notifications?

Yes. When a customer submits a new return, the plugin sends a confirmation email to the customer and a notification to the admin email configured in settings. Email notifications when return status changes are available in PRO.

What is included in Free versus PRO?

Free includes the full core return workflow for logged-in customers, admin dashboard, return list and details, settings, appearance, translations, and new-return email notifications. PRO adds guest returns, group returns, advanced reporting, automation, stock restore, store credit coupons, and the other features listed under PRO Features above.

Does it work with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility with WooCommerce custom order tables (HPOS).

Does the plugin call external services?

No. This release does not phone home, send telemetry, or contact a license server.
sections.changelog:
1.4.3

  • Readme: align free vs PRO feature lists with the current plugin split.
  • Document guest returns, group returns, store credit coupons, email templates, weekly reports, and other PRO-only features correctly.
  • Clarify that the free edition serves logged-in customers via My Account.

1.4.2

  • PRO features tab: benefit cards layout and updated PRO feature list.
  • Return options: built-in dropdown types with fixed IDs and legacy ID normalization.

1.4.1

  • Split free vs PRO: text-only PRO features tab; remove PRO-only settings from free UI.
  • Disable status-change emails in free; keep new-return notifications.

1.4.0

  • Rebrand and WordPress.org compliance release.
